I replied to Pree in a thread in #central-team: the Marrow Agrisupply store was **Pine Crossing**.

She brought it up there herself on June 9. The morning receiver said the appointment screen only showed the afternoon shift. A driver who arrived at 7:10 got his trailer number written on a sticky note instead of a booking.

If the account sheet needs a site code or address for Pine Crossing, I couldn't find one in any channel or file Pree can see, and I told her that in the reply.
